title.zh: Crypto.com registers with SEC for single-stock futures, plans US stock perps
title.en: Crypto.com registers with SEC for single-stock futures, plans US stock perps

current_state.zh: Crypto.com has registered with the SEC for single-stock futures and is working with the SEC and CFTC to offer single-stock perpetual futures in the US, according to CEO Kris Marszalek.
